description:

Featuring 16 Gigabit PoE+ ports, alongside 2 Gigabit uplink ports, it delivers reliable Gigabit connectivity while supplying power to compatible devices over Ethernet.

With a 250 W PoE power budget, the switch supports IEEE 802.3af/at standards, making it ideal for powering IP surveillance cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, access control systems, and other PoE-enabled devices.

As an Easy Smart Switch, the TL-SG1218MPE offers useful Layer 2 management features including VLAN, QoS, IGMP Snooping, Loop Prevention, and cable diagnostics, allowing businesses to optimise network performance without the complexity of fully managed switches.

Its durable metal housing, rack-mountable design, and intelligent PoE management make it an excellent choice for enterprise networks, hospitality, schools, offices, and CCTV deployments.

name: TP-Link LS1005G 5-Port Gigabit Desktop Switch
description:
The TP-Link LS1005G 5-Port Gigabit Desktop Switch is a compact, plug-and-play networking solution designed to expand wired connections for homes, small offices, and business environments. Equipped with five 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports, it delivers high-speed data transfer for bandwidth-intensive applications such as file sharing, HD video streaming, IP surveillance, and online collaboration.

Its unmanaged design eliminates the need for configuration, allowing users to simply connect devices and start networking immediately. The LS1005G supports Auto-Negotiation and Auto MDI/MDIX, automatically detecting the appropriate connection type to simplify installation.

Built with energy-efficient technology, the switch intelligently adjusts power consumption based on link status and cable length, helping reduce energy costs without compromising performance. Its fanless design ensures silent operation, making it suitable for offices, reception areas, classrooms, and home workspaces.

Whether you’re connecting computers, printers, NAS devices, IP cameras, or network storage, the LS1005G provides reliable Gigabit connectivity in a compact desktop form factor.
